title: Creating a task inserts two copies
summary: lib/store.ts createTask pushes the new task twice (the second copy gets a suffixed id), so one Add produces two list items and the active counter reads "2" instead of "1". The "creating a task shows it in the list and updates the counter" test fails at its counter assertion. Ground truth: the app is broken; the test is correct.

expectedFailure.testTitle: creating a task shows it in the list and updates the counter
